docs.marked.component: `Marked` records "who did what" on a node: the actor, action type, origin, and timestamp.
In multiplayer or replay, other participants need to see recent moves, captures, or discards.
Because the mark lives directly in the node tree, it travels naturally across the network and into
snapshots. The viewer's policy (`visibleMark()`) decides whether to display it, accounting for
time-to-live (TTL) and whether own moves should be shown.
import { node, Bounded, mark, installStockMarks, installStockMarkIcons } from "game-kit";
The kit ships standard action marks (`lifted`, `moved`, `captured`, `removed`, `flipped`, `thrown`,
`action`), rendered as corner badges tinted with the player's ink colour.
docs.marked.mark: A piece bearing an action mark. Switch the mark type and player seat in the panel: the corner
badge reflects the action icon and the actor's assigned color.
